title: Lesson 1 · am / is / are
title_zh: 第一课 · be动词 am / is / are
grammar: I am, you/we/they are, he/she/it is — statements, questions (Am I...? Are you...? Is he...?) and negatives (I'm not, you aren't...). Question word: where.
grammar_zh: be动词的用法：I am，you/we/they are，he/she/it is；肯定句、疑问句（Am I...? Are you...? Is he...?）和否定句（I'm not, you aren't...）；疑问词 where。

title: Lesson 2 · do
title_zh: 第二课 · 一般现在时 do
grammar: Present simple with do/does for habits and daily routine: Do you...? I don't..., What time do you...?
grammar_zh: 一般现在时 do/does，用来表达习惯和日常生活：Do you...? I don't..., What time do you...?

title: Lesson 3 · can / does
title_zh: 第三课 · 情态动词 can 与一般现在时 does
grammar: can/can't for ability and permission (Can you...? You can't...), plus more present simple with does/doesn't for he/she/it.
grammar_zh: 情态动词 can/can't 表示能力和许可（Can you...? You can't...），以及第三人称单数一般现在时 does/doesn't。

title: Lesson 4 · do / was
title_zh: 第四课 · like/love/hate + 动名词，was/were
grammar: like/love/hate/prefer/enjoy + verb-ing, and an introduction to was/were (past of am/is/are).
grammar_zh: like/love/hate/prefer/enjoy 加动名词(-ing)的用法，以及 was/were（am/is/are 的过去式）的入门。

title: Lesson 5 · did
title_zh: 第五课 · 一般过去时 did
grammar: Past simple: regular verbs (-ed), irregular verbs (go/went, have/had, get/got, eat/ate...), questions with Did...? and negatives with didn't.
grammar_zh: 一般过去时：规则动词加 -ed，不规则动词（go/went, have/had, get/got, eat/ate 等），疑问句 Did...? 和否定句 didn't。

title: Lesson 6 · there's / did / was
title_zh: 第六课 · there is/are 及过去时综合
grammar: There is / there are (and their past forms there was / there were) for saying what exists, combined with past simple review.
grammar_zh: There is / there are（以及过去式 there was / there were）表示某处存在某物，并综合复习一般过去时。
